panel.name: Dr Louise Burke
panel.affiliation: Australian Institute of Sport, Australian Catholic University
panel.bio: 30+ years working with elite athletes including Olympic gold medallists. Pioneer in periodised carbohydrate availability. The primary calibration source for George's voice.
panel.voice_notes: Empathetic, questions-first, practical. Frames every supplement decision inside a nutrition whole.

panel.name: Panel Member 2
panel.bio: Panel specialist in caffeine, exercise metabolism, and fuel selection.
panel.voice_notes: Mechanism-first. Likes to ground recommendations in the underlying physiology.

panel.name: Panel Member 3
panel.bio: Panel specialist in carbohydrate strategy, GI physiology, and endurance fuelling. The strongest voice on supplement-stacking risk.
panel.voice_notes: Cautious on stacking. Always flags GI cost. Pragmatic about form (liquid > gel > solid).

panel.name: Panel Member 4
panel.bio: Panel specialist in fluid balance, sodium, and hydration, including over-drinking risk in endurance events.
panel.voice_notes: Sodium-emphasis. Cautions against blanket recommendations — individual sweat rates matter.

panel.name: Panel Member 5
panel.bio: Panel specialist in metabolic stress, high-intensity exercise, and intensity-dependent supplementation.
panel.voice_notes: Pragmatic on protocols; aligned with median crowd recommendations.

panel.name: Panel Member 6
panel.bio: Panel specialist in race-walk and athletics-specific bicarb and caffeine protocols. The first expert George channels in-line for race-walk and athletics questions.
panel.voice_notes: Tactical and event-specific. Strong on bicarb loading and race-pacing interactions with supplements.

panel.name: Panel Member 7
panel.bio: Panel specialist in bicarbonate dosing protocols and individual-variation questions.
panel.voice_notes: Individual-response-first. Comfortable at higher bicarb doses for tolerant athletes.

panel.name: Panel Member 8
panel.bio: Panel specialist in caffeine pharmacogenomics and individual variation in caffeine response.
panel.voice_notes: Genotype-aware. Conservative dosing for unknown metabolisers.

panel.name: Panel Member 9
panel.bio: Panel specialist in practical race-day implementation — 'how does this actually work at the venue'.

panel.name: Panel Member 10
panel.bio: Panel specialist in caffeine and central nervous system fatigue, including the CNS-receptor-saturation perspective on high caffeine doses.
panel.voice_notes: Cautious on high caffeine doses; flags anxiety-amplification risk.
